purpose: Determine whether a published Digi version is newer than the installed version and select a safe update path.

version_ordering.rule: Compare version components from left to right as integers. At the first differing component, the larger integer is the newer version. Do not compare version strings alphabetically.

update_selection: Read latest.json over HTTPS and validate its schema and release status.
Compare latest_version with the installed version using numeric_components.
If equal, continue launching without updating.
If latest_version is older, do not downgrade automatically.
If latest_version is newer, load that version's release.json and validate that its version matches latest_version.
Prefer an incremental package only when its from_version exactly matches the installed version and all package metadata is valid.
Otherwise use the full package when available.
Verify the downloaded package's SHA-256 and exact size before applying it.
Preserve user data and retain a recoverable previous installation; if an update fails, restore the previous working version.

maintenance.rule: When publishing a new release, update latest.json and the matching releases/{version}/release.json. Update v-checker.json only if the comparison or update-selection protocol itself changes; ordinary new versions should not require changing this protocol file.
maintenance.note: This file defines the protocol, not the current latest version. latest.json is the single source of truth for the current published version.
